keyword_popups.text: สร้างกล้ามเนื้อ
กดส้นเท้าลง
ใช้งานส้นเท้าและก้น

edit_note: Three popups highlight the core message arc: building functional strength, the key heel-press technique on step-up, and the long-term benefit of activating heel and glutes over quads/knees.

cleanup.notes: Two main error types found: (1) ยอด/ย่อ tone confusion appearing twice — Whisper missed the falling tone on ย่อ and output the rising-tone ยอด; (2) เสือ/เสื่อ tone-mark drop on the mat word. The บ่าย/ปวด substitution is a classic unaspirated-stop consonant swap in a fitness pain-reduction context.

corrections.original: ยอดลงเนี่ย
corrections.corrected: ย่อลงเนี่ย
corrections.reason: ยอด (top/peak) makes no sense in a lunge cue; ย่อลง (lower down) is the standard fitness instruction for the descent phase

corrections.corrected: ฟังก์ชันนัล
corrections.reason: phonetic mis-spelling of English loan word 'functional'; ฟังก์ชันนัล is the standard Thai transliteration
บ่าย (afternoon) is nonsensical here; ปวดเจ็บ (ache/pain) fits the context of reducing daily-life discomfort — classic บ/ป consonant substitution
เสือ (tiger) is nonsensical; เสื่อ (mat) fits perfectly — a foldable exercise mat that makes heel-pressing easier; tone-mark error (missing mai ek)
spurious ล inserted after พอ; พอวางเข่า (when the knee is placed) matches the meaning in segment [8] which repeats the same phrase
same spurious ล as in [7]; this segment overlaps with [7] (แถม split across boundary) — แถมพอวางเข่า (moreover when placing the knee) is the intended phrase
same ยอด→ย่อ error as index [0]; ย่อลงไป (lower yourself down) is the correct fitness cue for the descent phase of the step-up
